book.name: Salmos
book.title: Israelchich Apanlleem yaseerangana anu Israelchich Apanlleem yaseerangana anu

content: Apaa, nuwaa nayiningandama. Yutaritshishireetsi tachingandama, Dapiy tárangu, anoo kamankiya
Dapiyarini Betsabeyaa yutarit patatarangu, anumandsha Natán nambarangu, Dapiyarinsha nee yandarangiya.

content.text: Apaa, shiy uru chinampanish taaksha.
Ashiri nuwaa nayaninganda. Yutaritshishireetsi tachingandama.
Mangeetsi izuuru tachingeerush, mburish wayangandama.
Nuw kizpur yutarit ashirangina, Apaa.
Anoo mbizamaam pinasakina.
Nuw shiyaa tayutaritarangina;
Nuw ashirangi anoo, shiy, Izuuru watsta, tárangsha.
Nuwaa wanimaam waritarangsha. Shiy tsinastishcha.
Shiy tputsee waneekchush,
¿Chaka shiyaa, yutarittishcha tách?
Itaru, nuw aneershi nllurtarangi anumandari yutarittana.
Itaru, shiysha tputsee mang' izuuru natstaksha.
Tputs shiyaa itsinsaru chinaku, shiysha wanasiri napaksha.
Anush Apaa, nuwaa mangi p'tseeksha mangoonamaama.
Ashiri Apaa, mangeetsi tchinganda.
Izuuru tachingeerush, mangi mburshinandarisha wayangandama, Apaa.
Nuwaa waneerangush, mangi kapung mantsakina.
Yusur shiyamun mangi tatkuri, mapiyri kis taapi, átana.
Istanda, Apaa.
Ashiri, yutaritshishireetsi mbizamamari izuuru kpitangcha, Apaa.
Nuwaa mangeetsi mburish tsarun ndunar ksangandama.
Sheerush, tuwizpurtangandama, shiyaa itsinsaru chinamaama.
Apaa, nuwaa iwanlltarinllpa.
Kanish wanasirimshee nuwaa itutsinllpa, Apaa.
Síru yutaritshishireetsi ichinguru tachingarangush, mangi kis taarangina.
Ashiri na ashiritam mangeetsi yusur isichinda.
Wizpurirpatish chinasheemi wanasir panangandama.
Ashkachush, nuwsha tputsee yutaritshishpanee shiyaa itsinsaru chinamaam tayaspatachima.
Ashkachuri, uwsha yusur shiyash itsinsartam tachitchitamtaya.
Nda tputsee pachamaam izuuru watsta aturi,
Apaa, nuwaa istangandama.
Apaa, shiy nuwaa tapachindarangsha.
Ashiri shiy nuwaa itsinsaru chinamaam istakush,
nuwsha yaseesshpati, shiyaa; Apanll itsinsampancha, tputsee kamankuri táchima.
Apaa, shiy nuwaa kuki mureem wayangandama.
Sheerush, nuwsha shiyaa ungirtakuri, k'kipti shiyaa yasichima.
Shiyaam chineetsi muchamaam pangipish wayapi tina.
Itaru, anpa yutaritshishee yaramaam nda shiy kis napachsha.
Tputsee yutaritshishimand mang' kapung mantsaku, anoo shiysha izuuru mangoo yaraksha.
Tputsee yutaritshshimand izuuru mang' mantsaku shiysha Apaa, mangoo yaramaam nda watsta átsha. Uru yaraksha.
Apaa, tputsireetsish shaana yaktarinish Siyonash shaniykusin, wanasir napaksha.
Irusarinaa watandpunu yusur mbammash wanasir wayamaama istangcha.
Wanasiri napkachush, tputsirish shiyaam wakaraatstam, opeejaatstam shiyaam muchkusin,
shiy tputsireetsish chinachpasha.
Yutaritshishirineetsi yarachsha.

footnotes.text: Yuwaa nish átu anootstam Romshucheema 3.4 tayusima kamankiya.
